basics.name: Alex Spaulding
basics.label: Systems Software / Apple Platforms / Compositors
basics.summary: Computer Science student at Eastern Washington University. Founder of Wawona, a native Wayland compositor for macOS, iOS, and Android. Also build macOS and iOS runtime tooling, reverse-engineering tools, and Nix infrastructure. Seeking internships or full-time as a Systems Software Engineer, Platform Engineer, or Developer Tools Engineer.

work.name: Wawona
highlights: Native Wayland compositor for macOS, iOS, and Android (200+ stars): Rust core, Metal and Vulkan, UniFFI, Nix toolchain, TestFlight.
On-device shell and userland, Wayland graphics compatibility (GBM, EGL, ANGLE), Waypipe remote apps.

work.name: Sunburst Sensors
highlights: Built and calibrated pCO2 and pH instruments; PCB soldering, firmware updates for 1,000+ microcontrollers, hydrostatic testing.

awards.title: Symposium poster: Native Wayland Compositing on Apple Ecosystems (Wawona)
Vice President, Association for Computing Machinery chapter
First place, Cyber Capture The Flag

publications.name: Native Wayland Compositing on Apple Ecosystems: Assessing the Feasibility of Wawona Compositor
publications.publisher: Student Research and Creative Works Symposium, Eastern Washington University
publications.summary: Assesses a native Wayland compositor for macOS, iOS, and Android. Wawona maps the Wayland protocol onto Metal, Core Animation, and the Android graphics pipeline, and shows unmodified Linux clients running on those platforms.
publications.author: Alex Spaulding
publications.imageAlt: Alex Spaulding presenting the Wawona Compositor poster at the 2026 Student Research and Creative Works Symposium
